item.title: Code hierarchy
item.description:
Namespaces

TrustLang supports namespaces; the separator, as in C++, is the double colon ::. A namespace can be specified both for an individual identifier and for a whole code block.

Unlike namespace in C++, namespaces in TrustLang serve not only to organize code into logical groups and to avoid name conflicts: a name in which a namespace is explicitly specified refers to static objects (memory for which is allocated at compile time).
